Tiger Shroff's team shares video of injuries after alleged firing incident

Tiger Shroff's team has shared a video showing injuries on his arm, featuring red marks and small pellet-like wounds. The video was released four days after an alleged firing incident. The actor's team shared the update to address 'haters'. Separately, NCP leader Supriya Sule expressed surprise over claims by the Bishnoi gang that the firing was carried out from jail.
